title: Read a project configuration
prompt: Return a Settings object for a project that checks null access and emits ES2022. The supplied Settings type contains strictNullChecks (boolean) and target (text). This exercise asks for a description of settings and leaves the course's real configuration intact.
hints: Name the option that checks null access.
Keep the checking choice separate from the emitted language level.
The requested target is an exact string.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Turns off the requested null check.

feedback: Name the option that checks null access.
